value.rationale: This answers a mathematically specific boundary highlighted by the motivating paper: interval width alone cannot supply a quantitative strictly positive entropy lower bound. For every prescribed positive width, a concrete analytic iid two-generator family has strictly positive quenched entropy at every parameter yet infimum zero, and its entropy obeys explicit logarithmic-order bounds. This provides a sharp limitation and identifies why recurrence data or regularity bounds must enter any uniform estimate.
